title: Private chat feature
desc: A feature to chat temporarily with artificial intelligence

full.overview: A private chat feature will soon be added to the site, which is for temporary chatting with artificial intelligence and will not be saved anywhere.

title: Updates Page & Changelog
desc: A dedicated changelog to track every change, improvement, and new feature. Protected by a password gate for admin-only access.

full.overview: Introduced a complete changelog system to track all changes made to VS-AI. Each update entry includes a summary card and a detailed slide-in panel with full breakdown of what was added, changed, or removed.
added: Updates page at /pages/soon/update with card-based layout
Password gate at /pages/pass for admin-only access
Slide-in detail panel when clicking update cards
Dark & light theme support with smooth transitions
Responsive design for mobile devices
changed: Sidebar "Updates" button now navigates to password gate instead of showing toast
Button CSS class renamed from ox-blogs-* to ox-updates-*

title: Sidebar Updates Button
desc: Added an Updates button to the sidebar that matches the New Chat button — supports collapsed and expanded states.

full.overview: A new "Updates" button was added to the sidebar chat list. It is dynamically injected via MutationObserver and matches the exact DOM structure and styling of the existing chat items.
added: Updates button with bell icon in sidebar chat list
Collapsed state: shows only the bell icon centered (like New Chat)
Expanded state: shows bell icon + "Updates" text + "Soon" badge
Hover states matching existing chat items exactly
CSS rules for .ox-updates-btn-item in collapsed/expanded modes
changed: Removed the floating FAB (Floating Action Button) that was added earlier
Removed header-based blog button in favor of list-based placement
removed: Header-area blog button in sidebar top

title: Version Badge Fix
desc: Fixed the version badge to fetch from /api/version dynamically. Displays correctly as v2.1.0.

full.overview: The version badge in the bottom-right corner of the chat was showing a broken placeholder. Fixed by switching from server-side HTML injection to client-side fetch from the /api/version endpoint.
added: Client-side fetch("/api/version") to dynamically update badge
Badge shows "v..." initially, then updates to actual version
changed: Server now only injects CSRF token into chat.html
removed: Unused meta tags: app-version, build-date, git-commit

title: PHP to Node.js Migration
desc: Complete migration from PHP/Apache to Node.js/Express. Includes SSE streaming proxy, CSRF protection, and Docker support.

full.overview: The entire backend was rewritten from PHP/Apache to Node.js/Express to solve Railway deployment issues (Apache MPM conflicts). The new stack preserves all security features while adding Docker containerization.
added: server.js — Express server with session, body parsing, and security middleware
SSE streaming proxy at POST /api/chat forwarding to upstream API
CSRF token generation and validation (session-bound, hex-encoded)
Per-IP sliding-window rate limiting (30 req/60s)
Request logging middleware with duration tracking
Health check endpoint at GET /health
Version API endpoint at GET /api/version
Dockerfile (Node 18 Alpine) with npm install --only=production
Automatic identity system message injection ("Your name is VS")
changed: Chat page now served by Express with runtime CSRF injection
Static files served by express.static() instead of Apache
Railway deploy now uses Dockerfile instead of Apache/Nginx
removed: Apache configuration: .htaccess rewrite rules (kept but unused)

title: Security Hardening
desc: Added security headers, session-bound CSRF tokens, and per-IP rate limiting.

full.overview: Multiple layers of security were added to protect the API proxy from abuse, including HTTP security headers, CSRF protection, and rate limiting.
added: X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff — prevents MIME type sniffing
X-Frame-Options: DENY — prevents clickjacking
X-XSS-Protection: 1; mode=block — XSS filter
Referrer-Policy: strict-origin-when-cross-origin
Permissions-Policy — disables camera, microphone, geolocation
Session-bound CSRF token (32-byte random hex)
CSRF validation via X-CSRF-TOKEN header on API requests
Per-IP sliding-window rate limiting (configurable via RATE_LIMIT env var)
Timing-safe CSRF comparison using crypto.timingSafeEqual
HTTP-only session cookies with SameSite=Lax
changed: Referer/Origin validation now checks against ALLOWED_ORIGINS env var
API errors returned as SSE events instead of plain JSON
removed: Direct API access without CSRF validation
